title: pathway declaration
description: This is argo-pack's OWN pathway schema. law-plank reads it out of this workspace at runtime, exactly as it reads yours out of yours — no copy of it is bundled into any .vsix. The vocabulary a pathway may use lives here rather than in the plank, which is the whole point of P4: the plank holds no table of pathways any more.

id.description: What a unit names under `pathway`. C7 requires a unit's pathway to resolve to a file in docs/pathways that declares this id.

effects.description: What work on this pathway is allowed to change. `direct` changes it and says so afterwards; `recorded` writes down what it did; `reviewed` needs a person to look before it lands; `gated` cannot proceed without one.

validation.description: How much checking the pathway owes before work on it is believed.

approvals.description: The human words this pathway offers — the points at which a person gets a say. C7 requires every human_word a unit claims to be one of these.

visibility.description: The surfaces work on this pathway appears on. Checked against docs/surfaces.yml where a workspace has one, and reported as unknown where it does not.

posture_budget.description: What work on this pathway may spend. `inherit` takes it from whatever dispatched the work. There is deliberately no way to say `off`: a pathway with no budget at all is a pathway nobody is accounting for.

ttl.description: How long a claim on this pathway stands before it returns to the pool, as an ISO 8601 duration.

stages.description: The stages work moves through, in order.

entry.description: What has to be true before work enters this stage.

verbs.description: What work may do in this stage. Checked against the workspace's tool manifest where it publishes one, and reported as unknown where it does not.

evidence.description: What this stage leaves behind that somebody could go and look at.

halt.description: What stops this stage. Every stage says what stops it — a stage with no halt is a stage that runs until something else notices.
